               if g[r][c] != bg and r not in (0, h-1) and c not in (0, w-1)]
    if not markers:
        return g
    target = Counter(v for _, _, v in markers).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Edge bars project alternating rays into the field. Marked cells set the
    # alternating phase and terminate their corresponding rays.
    edges = [
        (0, 0, 1, w),           # top: (fixed row, along columns, inward +1)
        (h-1, 0, -1, w),       # bottom

    for fixed, direction, inward, length in edges:

                i += 1
